summary: Independent Owner-amendment review of A0017 (layer CONTRACT; target tasks T087, T088, T102). RECORDED DIRECTION AND SCOPE: the direction names exactly those three tasks; git diff --name-status over base..candidate reports exactly seven paths - the three target contracts and todo/config.yaml (M) plus the three controller-written todo/amendments/A0017 records (A) - so nothing under src/, tests/, tools/, docs/, .github/, .claude/ or todo/schemas/ changed, docs/intent/ and docs/spec/ are byte-identical to the base, and there is no implementation or workflow-state change. CONFIG-FIELD BOUNDARY: a field-for-field comparison of base and candidate todo/config.yaml shows the only changed task field is T102's depends_on (now [T061, T101, T106], sorted and duplicate-free); no status, attempt, approved_commit, candidate_commit, evidence, latest_review, replaces, superseded_by, task set, active_task, workflow_state, intent_revision or spec_revision moved, T087 and T088 keep their dependency lists exactly as before, and all three targets were PLANNED at attempt 0 at the base and remain so - the amendment neither activates them nor consumes implementation attempts. IMPACT IDS INDEPENDENTLY CHECKED: the register holds 28 recorded impacts, of which A0015 and A0016 closed 10; the candidate resolves exactly four - A0014:T087:read-current-manifest-coverage, A0014:T088:reconcile-current-result-checksums, A0013:T102:legacy and A0014:T102:consume-schema-bound-robustness - each open at the base on a targeted task, and python -m tools.workflow status at the candidate reports the other fourteen open, matching the fourteen the rationale names exactly (A0013:T063/T064/T066/T067/T071/T072/T082/T085/T086/T091/T096/T103/T104:legacy and A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence), so the resolution is narrow and exact, not broad. T087 and T088 genuinely close their two A0014 impacts (normative T063 replaced by T105 as the range/coverage and checksum/provenance authority read through T069; registry- and schema-bound provenance; fail-closed states for failed, cancelled, missing or revision-mismatched runs; legacy artifacts read-only, byte-identical, labelled historical and never parsed as current; positive, negative, migration-fixture and old-path-unreachable acceptance added; every result-display obligation preserved), and A0013:T102:legacy is genuinely repaired (the model-backed component now needs a registered T068 identity obtained through the T068 registry, with parameter schema, version and code provenance, requested only by naming that identity through T069, refusing unregistered or inferred identities, and never requested by module or free-text name). A0014:T102:consume-schema-bound-robustness is closed for its CONTRACT, DEPENDENCY, IMPLEMENTATION, DATA, OPERATIONS and SECURITY dispositions (T106 added as a direct dependency, T064 replaced as the current protocol, fail-closed UNCERTAIN/NO_TRADE or blocked publication, legacy T064 artifacts read-only and non-current, T070 named as the risk boundary), but its VERIFICATION item is not fully carried by the contract text - see required change 1. IMPACT ASSESSMENT SPOT CHECKS: the Intent claims check out - G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01 is docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md:506, G-BACKTEST-RUN-01 :508, G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01 :509 and G-ML-01 :510, and no Intent revision moved; the specification claims check out - WEB_CONSOLE.md WEB-GLOBAL-002 :28-32, WEB-PAGE-012 :179 and WEB-PAGE-013 :191 (the cited ranges are tight but contain the requirements named), and DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md DS-021/DS-022/DS-035/DS-041 and STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md ECO-REGIME-001/ECO-EDGE-001 exist and are unchanged; the implementation claims check out - src/robinhood_lp has no web and no models module, robinhood_lp.reports carries the hard-coded five-name VALID_STRATEGY_KINDS vocabulary at src/robinhood_lp/reports/manifest.py:118, robinhood_lp.robustness.surfaces is the T064 parameter-surface module, and T105.md and T106.md Replacement and migration sections already specify those implementations' disposition, which this amendment leaves untouched; the operations, data and security claims are supported by the delivered text (one T105 manifest authority, one T069 run lifecycle, one T068 registry, no second publisher or surface builder; no approval, execution or promotion authority granted; T070 named in T102 without a dependency edge, measured: T070 is not in T102's closure); the dependencies claims are exact (closures of 44, T105 in T087/T088 reachable through T069, T102 additionally carrying T105 and T106, no cycle, config and contract lists identical). PRESERVATION: clause-by-clause comparison (difflib over base and candidate plus full reads) shows no T087, T088 or T102 deliverable, acceptance criterion or Must-not clause dropped or weakened; the changes are re-pointings (T063/T064 to T105/T106), scoping (the fallback covers model-artifact availability only) and extensions, all within the recorded direction; the T088 display obligations (price with Range band and event markers, equity with drawdown, PnL attribution with explicit residual, inventory with liquidity and raw integers, tick liquidity distribution, coverage gaps drawn as gaps, WEB-GLOBAL-007 layering, RELATIVE_ONLY, absent-manifest unknown state) are intact. The only remaining T063 occurrences in T087.md (five, at :36, :58, :63, :65, :73) and T088.md (four, at :44, :67, :71, :79) and T064 occurrences in T102.md (seven, at :60, :62, :87, :90, :94, :110, :112) are legacy renderings or prohibitions, each inspected - but the rationale's count for T087 is wrong (required change 2). One authoritative path, immutable history: the amendment creates no second authority and edits no prior amendment record, APPROVED contract, approval field or historical artifact. VERIFICATION REPRODUCED read-only in this worktree with the conda environment python 3.12.14: python -m tools.workflow validate = {status: OK}; python -m tools.check_citations check, python -m tools.check_acceptance check and python -m tools.check_imports check (with the CI suppressions, config and architecture paths) report no findings; PYTHONPATH=src pytest on the five named suites = 101 passed, matching the record; git diff --check over base..candidate is clean. A full-suite regression run gives 2316 passed, 6 skipped and 1 failed (tests/test_abi_artifacts.py::test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output), which is environmental, not caused by this amendment: the review worktree has no Foundry/forge toolchain and the vendored tools/oracle/lib Solidity sources are absent, and no file under src/, tests/ or tools/ differs from the base, so the outcome is identical at both commits. Non-blocking observations: the impact_assessment.specification citation ranges are tight but contain the cited content; the tools/workflow/core.py:1707-1716 citation covers the allowed-path rule while the config-field drift rule extends to :1735; and the rationale's phrase 'the three remaining T063 tokens' contradicts its own five-line list, which is required change 2. Verdict FAIL for two actionable defects: the recorded direction's positive verification item for T102 is absent from the contract while the impact assessment claims it, and the amendment rationale's occurrence arithmetic for T087 is wrong.
required_changes: Carry the recorded direction's positive verification item for T102: the Owner direction (todo/amendments/A0017/request.json) requires that verification 'covers positive evaluation over heterogeneous registered schemas', and A0014:T102:consume-schema-bound-robustness records the same under VERIFICATION ('positive evaluation for heterogeneous registered schemas'). The candidate todo/phases/P10-research-and-models/T102.md carries every other item of that disposition (undeclared/out-of-range/wrong-unit/wrong-type/wrong-revision refusals before any fold, the missing/legacy-only/mismatched T106 fail-closed case, refusal of an unregistered identity and of a run request that does not name one, the legacy T064 migration fixture with incompatible revisions never merged, and the old-path-unreachable proof) but contains no clause requiring the positive walk-forward evaluation to be exercised over at least two heterogeneous registered schemas (grep for 'heterogeneous', 'two' or 'multiple' finds none), while the planner's impact_assessment.verification claims 'positive T102 evaluation over heterogeneous registered schemas'. Because a CONTRACT amendment may edit its target contracts, add that clause to T102.md's acceptance (or an equivalent target-contract statement) so the positive case is schema-heterogeneity-tested at T102 exactly as directed; if the intent is instead that T106's own acceptance ('For at least two heterogeneous registered strategies...', todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T106.md:59-61) satisfies the item transitively, then record the re-measured mapping in the retry's record and drop the unsupported sentence from the impact assessment rather than leaving the claim standing unverified.

Correct the occurrence arithmetic in the amendment record for T087: the rationale in todo/amendments/A0017/planner-001.json says 'the three remaining T063 tokens in the edited file (T087.md:36, :58, :63, :65, :73)' while the file carries five T063 occurrences (grep -o counts exactly five, at those five lines); T088's four and T102's seven are correct. The substantive claim that every remaining occurrence is a legacy-only rendering or prohibition with no normative consumption is verified true, so only the number needs repair. A CONTRACT amendment may not edit planner-001.json (tools/workflow/core.py:1707-1716 restricts the change to the target contracts and todo/config.yaml), so state the re-measured count in the retry's own record and name the superseded wording, as A0016 attempt 2 did for its citation repair.
